summary: Keep reusable FedEx credentials environment-only and redact request PII, secrets, labels, and raw error bodies from routine output.
reason: Long-lived client credentials and shipment PII must not be serialized into configuration, logs, dry-run output, or model-visible error strings.
validated_outcome: Tests confirm reusable client IDs, client secrets, refresh tokens, static keys, and raw auth headers are absent from saved TOML; client secrets have no CLI flag; automatic OAuth minting keeps tokens memory-only unless caching is explicitly enabled; cached tokens require bounded future expiry; profiles cannot grant mutation authority; dry-run and API/OAuth errors contain no sentinel credentials, address, phone, email, or raw response body.
